name: Phone fan
what: Phones drop onto a pile one after another, then fan out like cards with the middle one forward, each showing a picture (yours or a colour) - an app showcase, several screens, a content mix.

learned_from.what: phones stacking and fanning out to show their screens

motion: phones drop 10 f each, 3 f apart; a beat; fan out 22 f (S-curve); then the fan breathes
